option_relations.rationale: High-grade (3A) follicular lymphoma is a distinct type of B-cell lymphoma, different from marginal zone lymphoma.

The option 'Marginal zone lymphoma' is directly equivalent to the primary diagnosis component of the provided leaf 'Marginal zone lymphoma (extranodal B-cell lymphoma) with pleural and mediastinal involvement, stage IV'.
Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is a distinct type of aggressive B-cell lymphoma, different from marginal zone lymphoma.
Primary mediastinal (thymic) large B-cell lymphoma is a distinct type of B-cell lymphoma, different from marginal zone lymphoma and typically presents in the mediastinum.
